# v0.3.23 — TheOne no longer changes your default model

## What's changed

- **Fixed: your default model stays yours.** DSH saves any chat's model choice as the default for new chats. Each time TheOne opened its main chat it picked TheOne as that chat's model, so DSH quietly made TheOne the default too, and new ordinary chats started going through TheOne. TheOne now keeps your default exactly as it was. If an earlier version already changed it, this version puts it back once, to the model you used before; if you chose TheOne as your default yourself, it is left alone.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (199) and type checks passed; checked in DSH that opening main chat leaves the default model unchanged.

## 中文

- **修复：默认模型不再被改动。** DSH 会把任何会话选的模型存成新会话的默认模型。TheOne 以前每次打开主聊天，都会给主聊天选上 TheOne，于是 DSH 也悄悄把默认模型改成了 TheOne，之后新建的普通会话也会经过 TheOne。现在 TheOne 会让你的默认模型保持原样。如果之前的版本已经改动过，这个版本会把它恢复成你原来用的模型，只恢复一次；如果是你自己把默认设成了 TheOne，则保持不变。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（199 项）和类型检查；并在 DSH 里实际确认：打开主聊天后，默认模型保持不变。
